description: This file defines a `RecordAudioDialog` class in Kotlin for an Android application. It provides UI for recording audio, manages permissions, interacts with a background recorder service, and handles user interaction for recording and canceling audio recordings.

classes.name: RecordAudioDialog
classes.description: A dialog fragment class enabling audio recording functionality, managing permissions, services, and UI interactions.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Inflates the layout binding for the dialog.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI, sets up button click listeners, and starts recording.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Requests microphone permission and manages dialog visibility.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up service bindings and resources.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Begins the recording process and updates UI with timer.

methods.name: stopRecording
methods.description: Stops recording, unbinds service, and sets fragment result with recorded attachment.

methods.name: bindRecorderService
methods.description: Starts and binds the recorder service.

methods.name: onPermissionGranted
methods.description: Handles actions after microphone permission is granted.

methods.name: requestMicrophonePermission
methods.description: Requests microphone permission from the user.
